examples.text: Danksagungen, das Vorwort und das Inhaltsverzeichnis können in Hausarbeiten römisch paginiert werden.

glosses: To number the pages of (a book or other document); to foliate.

examples.text: Each table is now paginated. That makes it straightforward if you wish to print a few pages of a long table by entering the page numbers required into the printer file.

glosses: To divide (a continuous stream of text) into pages.

examples.text: Word-processing applications are designed to automatically paginate a continuous flow of text, and this require additional capabilities such as page breaks and image-positioning for some control over page layout. However, this makes tasks such as laying out a double- page magazine spread very difficult.

glosses: To separate (data) into batches, so that it can be retrieved with a number of smaller requests.
Numéroter page par page un registre, un cahier, un livre.

examples.text: Il y aura deux pages de préface, il faut donc paginer à partir de 6 et non de 4.
